question: Which diverse beings are included among those who may seek this teaching?
premises: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakṣas, and asuras are named.
Ascetics rich in austerity are also included.
inference: Beings of many classes may be associated with this teaching.
uncertainties: garndhavāḥ appears to be a nonstandard spelling of gandharvāḥ.
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakṣas, asuras, and ascetics are included.
